item.title: Senior Product Data Scientist, ML Resource Efficiency - Google
item.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
### **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 8 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, performing statistical analysis, and coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL) or 5 years of experience with a Master's degree.
### **Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 8 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, performing statistical analysis, and coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL). * Experience working on Machine Learning Infrastructure.
**About the job** -----------------
Google’s bespoke ML TPU infrastructure is a rapidly growing investment driving performance beyond Moore’s Law. The Cloud ML Efficiency Data Science team provides insights and tools that enable product areas to efficiently consume ML resources for training and serving models.
In this high-visibility role, you will collaborate with Capital Engineering, Finance, PMs, and executive leadership to ensure the scalable and cost-effective deployment of ML compute across Google. Leveraging strong technical and analytical skills, you will uncover opportunities to improve efficiency through data transparency, software stack enhancements, user engagements, and service innovations like pricing and product tiers.
To succeed, you must be a strategic, agile problem solver who navigates ambiguity, acts with bias to action, and builds strong cross-functional relationships. You will partner closely with AI and Compute Enablement leads, regularly presenting findings to AI2 leadership.
Your work will directly, influence how Google optimizes investment, scaling ML infrastructure globally to meet the soaring demands of Google's ML products and research. You will engage with senior executives across Platforms, Research, Finance, and PA PARM teams to perfectly align our services with user needs.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.
**Responsibilities** --------------------
* Perform analysis utilizing relevant tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python). Help solve problems, narrowing down multiple options into the best approach, and take ownership of open-ended ambiguous business problems to reach an optimal solution. * Build new processes, procedures, methods, tests, and components with foresight to anticipate and address future issues. * Report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to support business reviews with the cross-functional/organizational leadership team. Translate analysis results to business insights or product improvement opportunities. * Build and prototype analysis and business cases iteratively to provide insights at scale. Develop comprehensive knowledge of Google data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed for product development. * Influence across teams to align resources and direction.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

item.title: Converge Signals, FSI - Data Scientist_Products & Platforms - Deloitte
item.description:
**The Team**
The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.
Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented **Data Scientist** to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.
**Position Summary**
Financial services data holds enormous, often-underused potential - and turning it into decisions the business can act on takes both rigorous technical craft and real industry fluency. As a Data Scientist on the Signals for FSI team, you'll build the analytical engine behind one of Converge for FSI's flagship products, working hands-on with real financial services data to develop models clients can trust. You'll do it on a team that pairs start-up speed with the scale and credibility of Deloitte, giving you room to experiment while your work reaches some of the most influential institutions in financial services.
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.
**Work you'll do**
As the Data Scientist, you will work at the intersection of data science, product, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the models and analytics that power Signals for FSI:
* Develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models using financial services datasets (e.g., consumers, businesses, transactions, accounts, risk, or market data) to power Signals for FSI. * Partner with the Product team to translate financial services use cases into data requirements, features, data signals, and model specifications. * Conduct exploratory data analysis and validate data quality across structured and semi-structured financial services data sources. * Evaluate model performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings. * Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams. * Stay current on emerging Statistical, AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes - early use cases are retail banking, investment and wealth management and insurance, but will expand over time. * Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a signal or model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement. * Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders. * Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once. * Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production. * Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * 4+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling, including hands-on model development and validation - proficient at using Python, SQL and other data transformation and analytical tools * Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
**Preferred:**
* Advanced degree (Master's) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, investment management, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients. * 2+ years of working with customer data to build audiences and segments for sales and marketing use cases. * Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context. * Experience with MCP servers and use of AI to analyze large data sets.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,000-$240,500.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist - Abbott
item.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
**Working at Abbott**
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:
* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. * Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year. * An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution * Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. * A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. * A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.
**About** **Lingo**
Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers – such as glucose, ketones, and lactate – to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.
**The opportunity**
Personalized healthcare is the future. Working on Lingo, you will help build a next-generation technology that enables individuals to make decisions about how to improve energy, lose weight or enhance athletic performance. The Lingo team embodies a start-up culture and mindset with the backing of Abbott, a company with a rich history of healthcare innovation. Join us and grow your career as you help Abbott shape the future of healthcare.
You will apply your strong expertise in artificial intelligence by using machine learning to design, prototype, and build next-generation advanced analytics engines and services. You will work closely with software engineers, data architects, designers, and product owners and develop AI features, predictive models using machine learning and other advanced analytics tools to increase and optimize customer experience, revenue generation, prospect targeting, and other business outcomes.
This position works out of our **Alameda, CA** location in Lingo.
**What you’ll do**
* Work within an agile team in a dynamic, fast-moving, collaborative environment and design complex analytics models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization * Develop data and model pipelines with tools like Azure ML SDK, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, or related technologies * Analyze large amounts of data to discover trends and patterns, and build analytics models * Ensure the highest level of data accessibility, security, and quality at all stages; create automated anomaly detection systems and monitor their performance and model drift * Effectively communicate complex ideas and results to both technical and business/executive audiences * Conduct advanced statistical and other analysis to provide actionable insights, identify trends, and measure performance * Create repeatable, interpretable, dynamic, and scalable models that are seamlessly incorporated into analytics data products * Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered conversational experiences, including chatbots and virtual assistants leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), intent classification, grounded responses, and policy-based controls.
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree, Advanced degree in computer science, biomedical, bioengineering, data science, or relevant, is preferred. * 8+ years of relevant experience in the data science/analytics space * Strong expertise in Python as well as proficiency in writing complex SQL queries * Proficiency in using machine learning to solve clustering, classification, regression, anomaly detection, simulation, and optimization problems on large-scale data sets
* Strong hands-on experience and expertise in one or more big data technologies, i.e., Hadoop, Spark, H20.ai, cloud AI platforms, containerization * Experience supporting deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of analytics models * Experience building and deploying AI-powered conversational solutions, including intent classification, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounded response generation, policy and guardrail implementation, validation methodologies, and evaluation frameworks for production use cases. * Up to date on industry trends within the analytics space from a data acquisition processing, engineering, and management perspective * High level of curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving capabilities
The base pay for this position is $114,000.00 – $228,000.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

item.title: Applied Scientist II, AWS Quick - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Come join the AWS Agentic AI science team in building the next generation models for intelligent automation.
AWS, the world-leading provider of cloud services, has fostered the creation and growth of countless new businesses, and is a positive force for good. Our customers bring problems that will give Applied Scientists like you endless opportunities to see your research have a positive and immediate impact in the world. You will have the opportunity to partner with technology and business teams to solve real-world problems, have access to virtually endless data and computational resources, and to world-class engineers and developers that can help bring your ideas into the world. As part of the team, we expect that you will develop innovative solutions to hard problems, and publish your findings at peer reviewed conferences and workshops.
We are looking for world class researchers with experience in one or more of the following areas - autonomous agents, API orchestration, Planning, large multimodal models (especially vision-language models), reinforcement learning (RL) and sequential decision making.
* Define and implement new automated reasoning features that employ scalable and efficient approaches to solve complex problems using neural learning and symbolic/formal reasoning * Apply software engineering best practices to ensure a high standard of quality for all team deliverables * Work in an agile, startup-like development environment * Deliver high-quality scientific artifacts * Work with the team to help drive business decisions

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist - Pacific Gas and Electric
item.description:
Requisition ID # 175422
**Job Category:** Engineering / Science
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
**Work Type:** Hybrid
**Job Location:** Danville; San Ramon
Department Overview
Electric Transmission & Distribution ensures the delivery of clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy to nearly 16 million people in Northern and Central California. The Electric Transmission & Distribution Team is responsible for ensuring the electric grid's reliability and resiliency through the ongoing maintenance and operations of PG&E's 100,000 miles of distribution lines and over 18,000 miles of Transmission lines. Coworkers in Electric Transmission & Distribution actively engage in the Lean Methodology through the use of visual management in operating reviews to cross-functionally identify and solve problems, and create standard work. By working together as One Electric. One Team. We are delivering for our hometowns. Electric Transmission & Distribution is comprised of approximately 6,500 coworkers.
Position Summary
The Applied Technology Services (ATS) staff provides advanced analytical, modeling, testing, and risk assessment services across multiple disciplines to support company organizations in identifying, quantifying, and addressing complex operational and asset-related risks. The team develops and applies statistical, probabilistic, and machine learning-based approaches to evaluate system performance, asset condition, degradation trends, and probability of failure, enabling data-driven decision making for reliability, resilience, and lifecycle management.
Staff integrate and analyze diverse data sources to develop predictive models, risk metrics, and analytical tools that support asset strategy, maintenance planning, investment prioritization, and operational decision making. Services include asset health assessments, reliability and risk evaluations, failure investigations, scenario analyses, and development of quantitative methodologies for complex infrastructure systems, including transmission and distribution assets, distributed energy resources, and generation facilities.
The team provides technical consultation and analytical insights to internal clients, helping organizations proactively manage risk and improve asset performance through the application of advanced modeling techniques, data analytics, and industry best practices. Staff collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to develop analytical solutions, support project proposals, and communicate complex model results and risk insights to decision makers. Incumbents maintain knowledge of and adhere to all company and regulatory safety, quality, and governance requirements.
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need.
The selected candidate must live within PG&E’s service territory.
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.​
**A reasonable salary range is:** Minimum Base Salary (Bay Area) $126,000.00
Mid Base Salary (Bay Area) $163,000.00
Maximum Base Salary (Bay Area) $200,000.00
Job Responsibilities Researches and applies knowledge of existing and emerging data science principles, theories, and techniques to inform business decisions. Creates data mining architectures / models / protocols, statistical reporting, and data analysis methodologies to identify trends in structured and unstructured data sets. Extracts, transforms, and loads data from dissimilar sources from across PG&E for their machine learning feature engineering. Applies data science/ machine learning /artificial intelligence methods to develop defensible and reproducible predictive or optimization models, Co-develops mathematical models and AI simulations that represent complex business problems. Writes and documents python code for data science (feature engineering and machine learning modeling) independently. Develops and presents summary presentations to business. Develops statistical, probabilistic, and machine learning models for asset condition assessment, degradation analysis, probability of failure estimation, and risk quantification to support risk-informed decision making. Develops and maintains probability of failure models, risk metrics, and analytical tools using asset condition, inspection, operational, environmental, and historical performance data to support asset strategy, reliability, maintenance, and lifecycle decisions. Performs model evaluation, sensitivity and scenario analyses, and quantification of uncertainty, and communicates model results, assumptions, failure drivers, and risk insights to engineering, asset management, operational, and business stakeholders.
Qualifications
Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Econometrics or Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Applied Sciences, Statistics, or equivalent field. 4 years in data science (or 2 years, if possess Master’s Degree, as described above).
**Desired:** Master’s Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Econometrics or Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Applied Sciences, Statistics, or equivalent field. Relevant industry (electric or gas utility, renewable energy, analytics consulting, etc.) experience Demonstrated knowledge of and abilities with data science standards and processes (model evaluation, optimization, feature engineering, etc.) along with best practices to implement them Competency in software engineering, statistics, and machine learning techniques as they apply to data science deployment Competency in commonly used data science and/or operations research programming languages, packages, and tools Hands-on and theoretical experience of data science/machine learning models and algorithms Ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and translate those insights into decisions and actions. Demonstrated ability to explain in breadth and depth technical concepts including but not limited to statistical inference, machine learning algorithms, software engineering, model deployment pipelines. Competency in the mathematical and statistical fields that underpin data science Mastery in systems thinking and structuring complex problems Ability to develop, coach and teach career level data scientists in data science/artificial intelligence/machine learning techniques and technologies

item.title: Senior Data Scientist – Finance - NVIDIA
item.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
Join NVIDIA as a Senior Data Scientist on our Finance Data Science and AI team, where you will work alongside Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI developers to lead the integration of innovative Data Science and AI solutions into our financial processes. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to challenge the status quo, constantly innovate and break down complex problems, and communicate technical solutions effectively across organizations.
**What you'll be doing:**
* Combine business insight and the data science toolkit to support critical finance data science initiatives using traditional machine learning, Bayesian statistics, simulation, and optimization. * Integrate AI tools and Agents into data science workflows, experimenting with new technology to determine where it can add organizational value. * Translate technical solutions into business terms and business requests into technical solutions. Ensure both technical and nontechnical collaborators understand the value, risks, and return on investment of Data Science projects. * Experiment with new technologies in the Generative AI space to identify high-value organizational use cases, from automated auditing to predictive forecasting.
**What we need to see:**
* 5+ years of professional experience in business-centered AI and Data Science, with a demonstrated history of implementing models in production environments. * Hands-on experience developing custom agents and multi-agent systems; proficiency with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and agent orchestration frameworks. * BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or other Engineering fields. Technical Master’s or Ph.D. with a finance or business background is preferred. * Strong technical skills, with a proven history of designing, validating, deploying, and maintaining data science models using Python, SQL, & Databricks (or similar). * Data Science project management experience, including collaborating closely with multiple collaborators to drive projects and coordinating resources within the organization. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to document and present complex technical findings and project status to technical and business collaborators.
**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**
* Operations finance or other applied, business-focused data science experience, especially at a larger company or in the semiconductor/tech industry. * A history of creative solutions bringing to bear data science and agentic technologies to resolve legacy bottlenecks, improve decision making, and add business value to an organization. * Development background with NVIDIA software libraries and GPUs, and OpenACC, CUDA optimization experience.
Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

152,000 USD – 230,000 USD for Level 3; and 168,000 USD – 264,500 USD for Level 4.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026.

item.title: Data Scientist III - Kaiser Permanente
item.description:
**Overview:**
The Risk Adjustment Data Management and Integrity team provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and ACA risk-related data to support key business initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong SQL and data transformation skills, experience managing large datasets, and a background in healthcare analytics or risk adjustment. Success in this role requires strong quality assurance, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
The Data Scientist III develops and applies advanced analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve risk adjustment data quality, throughput, and operational effectiveness. This role analyzes complex healthcare datasets, identifies data integrity issues and remediation opportunities, and develops predictive models and automated solutions to enhance the accuracy and completeness of risk adjustment submissions. Leveraging Python, SQL, Databricks, and machine learning technologies, the Data Scientist III helps drive the transition from rules-based analysis to predictive, intelligence-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate has experience with healthcare and risk adjustment data, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and process optimization, along with strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
**Job Summary:**
This individual contributor is primarily responsible for participating in the design and development of data pipelines and automation for data acquisition and ingestion of raw data from multiple data sources and data formats under the guidance of more senior data scientists. This role is also responsible for developing detailed problem statements outlining hypotheses and their effect on target clients/customers, analyzing and investigating data sets and summarizing key characteristics, selecting, manipulating and transforming data into features used in machine learning algorithms, training statistical models under the guidance of more senior data scientists, deploying and maintaining reliable and efficient models through production, verifying model performance, and working with internal and external stakeholders across domains to develop and deliver statistical driven outcomes.
**Essential Responsibilities:**
* Pursues effective relationships with others by proactively providing resources, information, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides mentoring to team members. Pursues self-development; creates plans and takes action to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; influences others through technical explanations and examples. Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Supports and responds to the needs of others to support a business outcome. * Completes work assignments autonomously by applying up-to-date expertise in subject area to generate creative solutions; ensures all procedures and policies are followed; leverages an understanding of data and resources to support projects or initiatives. Collaborates cross-functionally to solve business problems; escalates issues or risks as appropriate; communicates progress and information. Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. item.title: Senior Product Data Scientist - Ｃollective
item.description:
**About Collective:**
Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork.
Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures, QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.
**About the role:**
We’re hiring a Senior Product Data Scientist to build and evolve the core product experiences that power Collective’s member platform. You’ll be the analytical voice in product strategy, working with product, engineering, Operations, Finance, and Go-to-Market to turn member behavior across incorporation, bookkeeping, tax, and payroll into clear insights that shape the roadmap. You’ll own the metrics and analysis behind key decisions end to end, from defining what we measure to making sure the underlying data holds up. This role directly shapes how we help self-employed members save time and money, and how we grow and retain them.
This is a hands-on role for someone who cares about data quality, takes ownership of production systems end-to-end, and wants their work to be the foundation the rest of the company builds on.
**What you'll do:**
* **Drive product strategy with stakeholders.** Work closely with product leads, engineering, Operations, Finance, and Go-to-Market. Share product insights regularly, shape the roadmap, and push back with evidence when the data says something different. * **Lead product analytics.** Approach problems from first principles and turn large, messy datasets into clear analysis and visuals that get to the "so what" and drive product insights across incorporation, bookkeeping, tax, and payroll. * **Use data science to uncover member behavior.** Apply statistical and modeling techniques such as segmentation, cohort, retention, and churn analysis to understand what members do, why they do it, and what it means for the product. * **Find and size growth.** Identify opportunities to grow membership and retention, size them, and help product leads prioritize what to build for the biggest long-term impact. * **Own the metrics.** Define, build, monitor, and report on the metrics behind product strategy and key initiatives, with one tested definition for each. * **Build the data you analyze.** Take raw sources (our product database, payments, support, and third-party tools) through Fivetran and dbt in BigQuery into clean, tested, documented datasets that the whole company can use. Fix problems at the source, not downstream. * **Keep it trustworthy.** Add tests, monitoring, and lineage so a number can be checked in minutes rather than believed on faith. * **Make the data agent-ready.** Maintain the definitions, semantic layer, and documentation that let Claude and our internal data agents answer questions correctly for anyone making a decision. * **Work with urgency and judgment.** Pick up ambiguous, open-ended questions with minimal direction, and deliver with attention to detail.
**What you'll bring:**
* **Experience:** 6+ years in data science, product analytics, analytics engineering, or data engineering, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company. A bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, or a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **An owner's mindset:** you are curious, keep asking "why" until you reach the bottom of a problem, and take initiative without waiting for a ticket. You take ambiguous, high-impact questions and see them through to a decision. * **Range across both sides:** you may be stronger in one, but you can do real work in the other. You can run an experiment analysis on Monday and fix a broken pipeline or model on Tuesday. * **SQL and Python (or R):** expert SQL and strong scripting for analysis, statistics, and tooling. * **Data engineering you have done yourself:** you have taken messy raw sources to trusted, tested datasets that other teams rely on, using a modern stack such as BigQuery, dbt, and Fivetran or similar. You know what good data looks like. * **Experimentation:** you design and interpret A/B and multivariate tests, understand power and guardrails, and build frameworks that turn results into launch decisions. Experience with Statsig, LaunchDarkly, or similar. * **Product analytics:** hands-on with Amplitude, Segment, Metabase, or similar. You turn complex datasets into actionable insights, and you can run exploratory analysis with minimal direction. * **Product sense:** you think through the detailed elements of a product experience and bring creative ideas for growth. * **Communication:** you tell clear, compelling stories with data and explain trade-offs to product leads and cross-functional partners.
**Nice to have:**
* Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment * Exposure to financial, accounting, tax, or payroll data and the correctness bar that comes with it * Experience building semantic layers or metric stores that LLM-based tools query, or running LLM evaluations * AI-assisted development experience (Claude Code or similar) * Prior consulting or investment banking experience * Reforge or similar growth and product certifications
**What we offer:**
* **Hybrid Work Model:** Based in San Francisco with a balance of in-office and remote flexibility. * **Fresh Lunch:** Provided on in-office days. * **Commuter Support:** $150 monthly reimbursement for transit expenses. * **Health & Wellness:** $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being. * **Time Off:** Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays. * **Comprehensive Coverage:** 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents. * **Parental Leave:** 16 weeks fully paid. * **Retirement & Ownership**: 401k plan plus an equity package. * **Team Connection:** Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit.
Compensation Range: $180K - $230K

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Frontier AI Assets , Frontier AI Assets - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Frontier AI Assets (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Principal Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning and reinforcement learning background to build the training and evaluation assets that advance frontier Generative AI (GenAI) with Large Language Models (LLMs).
AI models become more capable largely because of the learning environments, the RL gyms, in which they are trained. FAI builds those gyms and the platform that certifies them, so that model training teams across Amazon can rely on high-quality, graded assets. As a Principal on this team, you will set the technical direction for how these gyms and the tooling around them are built, evaluated, and scaled.
Key job responsibilities As a Principal Applied Scientist with FAI, you will:
* Set technical direction across data collection, sampling, and evaluation for RL gyms focused on agentic tool use across a range of real-world domains. * Design and lead experiments that produce reliable, efficient signal on what drives model improvement. * Build gym-building tooling and automated quality control that scale with demand. * Advance the science of how gyms are evaluated and validated before they're used in model training. * Act as a hands-on technical leader: produce exemplary, high-quality assets yourself, and audit and support more junior scientists and engineers. * Partner closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams, turning real-world problems into challenging, high-value tasks. * Lead scientific reviews, scrutinize experimental design and verification, probe assumptions, and align teams toward coherent strategies. Contribute to hiring, mentorship, and the development of other scientists.
About the team The FAI team has the mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers. We build frontier training and evaluation assets, RL gyms and the certification platform behind them, that directly shape how Amazon's models are trained and improved. We value scientific depth, hands-on building, and turning research into measurable impact at scale.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or Master's degree with significant additional applied research experience. * Strong hands-on experience building machine learning models and systems for real-world applications, with deep learning and neural methods. * Experience with reinforcement learning and/or building RL gyms, learning environments, or agentic tool-use systems. * Experience setting technical direction across data, modeling, and evaluation, and dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives. * Experience leading experienced scientists/engineers and developing more junior members.
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Experience building automated evaluation, quality-control, or verification tooling for training data or environments. * Experience with agentic tool use and improving the capabilities of LLMs (for example multi-step, tool-using agents). * Track record of creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art; peer-reviewed contributions in premier journals and conferences. * Experience with large-scale distributed training/compute and modern ML frameworks.

item.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth - OpenAI
item.description:
Data Science - San Francisco and Seattle
**About the Team**
Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.
**About the Role**
In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.
A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.
**In This Role, You Will:**
* Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth. * Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API. * Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage. * Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider. * Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.
**You Might Thrive in This Role If You:**
* Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest. * Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.
**Qualifications**
* Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision. * Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads. * Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business. * Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.
**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

As a **Staff Data Scientist,** you will operate as a senior individual contributor, partnering closely with peers and leaders to identify, validate, and refine innovative growth strategies. Your expertise—especially in causal inference and advanced analytics—will be instrumental in surfacing critical insights and translating them into actionable hypotheses that fuel sustained customer and revenue growth.
**Responsibilities**
**Set Technical Vision and Strategy:**
* Contribute to and help refine a data science roadmap aimed at driving product funnel optimization and scalable growth initiatives. * Apply rigorous causal inference methods, advanced statistical modeling, and machine learning techniques to turn complex data into actionable insights.
**Drive Deep Analytics & Experimentation:**
* Develop an integrated view of the customer journey across various business metrics, quickly familiarizing yourself with new areas to pinpoint growth opportunities. * Design, implement, and analyze targeted experiments to validate hypotheses, ensuring each initiative is built on data-driven insights and sound causal analysis.
**Collaborate Across Functions:**
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other cross-functional teams to translate data insights into strategic product enhancements. * Support ongoing improvements in instrumentation, data quality, and logging practices to enrich our analytical capabilities and understanding of customer behavior.
**Lead by Example:**
* Serve as a technical SME within the Product Growth team, championing analytical rigor and innovative problem-solving approaches.
**Operate with Agility and Impact:**
* Rapidly assimilate diverse business metrics and data sources to uncover insights and propose high-impact hypotheses. * Balance rigorous technical analysis with swift, iterative execution to ensure that insights are quickly transformed into effective strategies.
**Qualifications**
**Experience & Expertise:**
* 5+ years of experience in data science or analytics, with a proven record of applying advanced analytical methods to drive product and business growth. * Demonstrated proficiency in causal inference techniques, statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimental design.
**Technical Proficiency:**
* Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, and other analytical tools, with practical experience using data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to communicate insights. * Experience with data integration and pipeline development is a plus.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership:**
* Strong ability to quickly understand new business areas, mastering the essential data and metrics needed for informed decision-making. * Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a track record of effectively influencing both technical and non-technical stakeholders through data-driven insights.
**Mindset & Attributes:**
* A relentless focus on customer centricity, with deep empathy and a commitment to uncovering opportunities that improve customer experiences. * An agile, entrepreneurial mindset, capable of balancing long-term strategic initiatives with rapid, iterative experimentation.

item.title: Applied Scientist, AWS Agentic AI - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Great code assistants have to understand code the way an experienced engineer does, not as a wall of text but as a living structure of symbols, calls, types, and dependencies that span an entire repository. Most AI tools today flatten all of that into tokens and lose the structure that makes real software navigable. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to fix that, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist to build the intelligence layer that lets our AI development tools reason about code through its true structure. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.
You will design how we turn the many signals around code, from static analysis and symbol graphs to build systems and language servers, into a single unified representation our models can reason over. This is a build-oriented research role where the questions are still open: how to fuse heterogeneous code signals, how to represent a whole repository so a model can find and use the right context, and how to ground an assistant's reasoning in the structure of real software rather than text alone. Your work will reach millions of developers, and you will own this direction end to end, from framing the approach to shipping it in a product engineers rely on every day.
Key job responsibilities
* Design a unified representation of code that fuses static analysis, symbol and call graphs, type information, and build system context
* Build the methods and models that consume that representation to power code navigation, retrieval, and reasoning at repository scale
* Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale
* Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide
* Publish and present your work at premier ML, NLP, and software engineering conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ICSE, FSE)
* Accelerate innovation by working directly with customers to rapidly transition research breakthroughs into production systems
About the team Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Hybrid Work We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our U.S. Amazon offices.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 3+ years of building models for business application experience * PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development

item.title: Staff Data Scientist - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
Mailchimp is a leading marketing automation platform that empowers millions of businesses to grow through powerful, easy-to-use marketing and messaging solutions. As we expand beyond email into omnichannel customer engagement, Messaging is at the forefront of Mailchimp's growth strategy, helping businesses connect with their customers through SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and other emerging communication channels.
Come join the **Mailchimp Product Data Science team as a Staff Data Scientist supporting Messaging**, one of our most exciting and strategically important growth areas. We are looking for a creative, business-minded problem solver who is passionate about leveraging data science to unlock customer value, accelerate product innovation, and drive measurable business impact.
As a **Staff Data Scientist,** you will serve as a **senior individual contributor and strategic thought partner** to Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Product Marketing leaders. You will tackle complex, high-impact business problems across the messaging customer journey—from adoption and engagement to monetization, retention, and revenue growth. Your expertise in advanced analytics, experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and automation will be instrumental in identifying growth opportunities, shaping product strategy, and influencing investment decisions.
This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of Mailchimp's omnichannel messaging strategy. You will lead strategic research, develop scalable data products and measurement frameworks, and translate complex insights into actionable recommendations that influence product roadmaps and accelerate business outcomes. Beyond individual projects, you will help elevate data science capabilities across teams, break down organizational silos, and establish analytical approaches that scale across the broader Mailchimp ecosystem.
**Responsibilities**
* **Strategic Data Partnership & Influence:** Serve as a trusted data science partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Product Marketing leaders, shaping Mailchimp's omnichannel messaging strategy across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and emerging channels. Influence product roadmaps, investment priorities, and business decisions through data-driven insights. * **Product Strategy & Revenue Growth:** Identify, size, and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities across the messaging customer journey, including acquisition, adoption, activation, engagement, monetization, and retention. Translate ambiguous business challenges into rigorous analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations that accelerate customer and revenue growth. * **Advanced Analytics & Causal Inference:** Lead complex, end-to-end analytical investigations using advanced statistics, SQL, Python, machine learning, and causal inference. Design and evaluate A/B tests and quasi-experiments (e.g., difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control) to establish causal relationships, quantify incremental impact, and guide product decisions. * **Measurement Strategy & Experimentation:** Develop scalable measurement frameworks and define success metrics to evaluate messaging product performance, customer outcomes, and business impact. Champion experimentation best practices and analytical rigor to enable faster, more confident decision-making. * **Scalable Data Products & AI Innovation:** Build reusable analytical frameworks, automated insights, opportunity-sizing tools, and self-service data products that democratize access to insights and scale Data Science impact. Leverage modern AI/ML techniques and AI-assisted tools to accelerate analytical workflows and improve organizational productivity. * **Predictive Modeling & Customer Intelligence:** Apply machine learning, predictive modeling, and customer segmentation to uncover behavioral patterns, identify growth opportunities, and optimize messaging adoption, engagement, and customer lifetime value. * **Data Quality & Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Data Engineering and platform teams to improve data instrumentation, quality, reliability, and accessibility. Break down organizational silos by developing consistent metrics, sharing learnings, and scaling analytical solutions across messaging channels and the broader Mailchimp ecosystem. * **Executive Communication & Technical Leadership:** Translate complex analytical findings into compelling, actionable narratives for technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including senior leadership. Provide technical thought leadership, mentor peers, and elevate the organization's standards for data-driven decision-making, experimentation, and innovation.
**Qualifications**
* **8+ years of experience** in Data Science, Product Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a demonstrated track record of driving measurable customer, product, and revenue impact in SaaS, marketing technology, or digital products. * **Deep expertise in advanced analytics, experimentation, and causal inference**, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control, regression discontinuity). Demonstrated ability to select and apply rigorous methodologies to ambiguous business problems and quantify incremental impact. * **Strong foundation in predictive modeling and machine learning**, including customer segmentation, propensity modeling, churn prediction, with experience translating models and insights into actionable product and business decisions. * **Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python** (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), with hands-on experience analyzing large, complex datasets, developing statistical models, and building scalable analytical solutions. * **Strong product and business acumen**, with experience identifying and sizing growth opportunities, evaluating product performance, and influencing strategies related to customer acquisition, adoption, engagement, monetization, and retention. * **Experience building scalable data products and analytical frameworks**, including automated insights, opportunity-sizing tools, and self-service solutions that improve decision-making and extend Data Science impact beyond individual analyses. * **Working fluency with modern AI tools and workflows**, including LLM-based coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) and AI-assisted analytics, with the ability to accelerate analytical development while maintaining high standards for accuracy, reproducibility, and rigor. * **Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and influence cross-functional stakeholders**, independently leading complex analytical initiatives and translating insights into strategic recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. * **Exceptional communication and data storytelling skills**, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Marketing. * **Bachelor's degree** in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in **messaging, marketing automation, communications platforms, or omnichannel customer engagement**, including SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, or email marketing. * Experience with **SaaS monetization, usage-based pricing, product-led growth, and customer lifecycle optimization**. * Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, establishing analytical best practices, and scaling data science capabilities across teams.

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Real-Time Conversational AI , AGI - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to drive the research and development of real-time multimodal conversational AI. You will operate across two focus areas: advancing foundation models for speech and audio, and building the post-training systems (reward modeling, reinforcement learning) that shape natural, human-like conversational behavior.
You will be the expert in your area while contributing across the full model lifecycle — from pre-training and architecture design through post-training alignment and real-time deployment. You will work at the frontier of what's possible in conversational AI, with the compute, data, and runway to pursue problems that few teams in the world have the resources to tackle.
As a Principal Scientist, you will set the technical direction for your research area, influence the broader roadmap, and work closely with inference engineers to ensure your models are designed for real-time production deployment from inception.
Key job responsibilities Foundation Model Scaling
* Build and train large-scale multimodal foundation models for real-time speech and audio generation, from architecture design through production-scale training
* Advance the scaling and efficiency of conversational modes, including the relationship between data, model size, and real time performance.
* Design model architectures informed by hardware constraints and inference requirements, working with inference engineers to ensure models are servable from inception
* Develop training methodologies for multimodal models that jointly process and generate speech, language, and audio in real-time streaming contexts
Post-Training & Reinforcement Learning
* Design and build reward models and reward functions for speech systems — capturing naturalness, fluency, conversational quality, and real-time responsiveness
* Develop and apply reinforcement learning methods to shape conversational behavior — teaching models natural timing, responsiveness, and fluid interaction
* Build the post-training pipeline from SFT through RL alignment, optimized for real-time multimodal outputs rather than text-only generation
* Design evaluation frameworks that capture the quality dimensions unique to real-time conversation
Real-Time Perception & Generation
* Advance the team's capabilities in real-time perception
* Work at the intersection of model architecture and production constraints to ensure multimodal capabilities function within hard real-time latency budgets
About the team We are a small, focused group of scientists and engineers building the next generation of real-time conversational AI at Amazon — models that interact naturally across speech and audio. We operate with the autonomy and pace of a research lab, backed by frontier-scale compute and a multi-year investment horizon.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Speech/Audio Processing, or equivalent quantitative field * 10+ years of applied research experience (industry or combined academic + industry) * Demonstrated experience training large-scale foundation models — hands-on involvement in scaling exercises, not just using pre-trained models * Experience with multimodal model architectures that jointly process or generate across speech, text, and audio modalities * Strong understanding of transformer architectures and their application to speech/audio domains * Publication record at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, Interspeech, ICASSP, ACL, or equivalent) * Demonstrated Principal/Staff+ scientific leadership — setting research direction, mentoring researchers, influencing multi-team decisions
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Hands-on experience building real-time AI systems — speech, audio, or video * Track record with post-training methods: reinforcement learning, reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF, or alignment techniques applied to generative models * Experience with real-time interactive systems — models that handle concurrent input and output * Experience building speech-to-speech or audio-to-audio generative models (codec models, autoregressive audio generation) * Hands-on design of reward models or reward functions specifically for speech/audio quality, naturalness, or conversational behavior * Experience with distributed training at scale — including parallelism strategies, training stability, and curriculum design * Familiarity with hardware-informed model design — understanding how architecture choices affect inference latency, memory, and cost * Background in speech recognition, speech synthesis (TTS), or speech enhancement * Experience shipping research to production at scale — models serving real users, not just benchmark results * Contributions to open-source speech/audio ML systems or widely used research codebases * History of mentoring and growing research teams from individual contributors to technical leaders

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models) - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models) builds the agentic AI systems behind next-generation advertising. The team develops multimodal foundation models and LLM-driven agents that power shopper understanding, audience-aware creative generation, and agentic advertising workflows.
As a Principal Applied Scientist for the FAIM team, you will invent the models that help advertisers achieve desired outcomes. Today's state of the art models can setup ad campaigns to a specification, but do not understand advertising strategy well enough to help with abstract goals that real advertisers ask about like "how can I make more money."
This is a rare charter to build foundational optimization science where little exists today, spanning campaign recommendation, cross-product budget allocation, incrementality measurement, and long-term-sales modeling. You will set technical direction for a growing team, partner with engineering and product to take models from research to production at Amazon scale, and directly move advertiser ROAS and new-to-brand growth.
In this role you will
* Own the science vision for developing evaluations of the Ads Agent * Partner with scientists from across Ads to develop best practices for evaluating agent performance both online and offline * Raise the science bar for all agent evaluations developed in Ads. * Own establishing a data driven foundation for making decisions about when new features are ready to launch in Ads Agent.
Key job responsibilities
* Define the long-term scientific vision for agent evaluations in Ads * Translate ambiguous advertiser needs and competing objectives into a concrete science roadmap. * Invent, prototype, and productionize machine learning and optimization solutions for joint budget allocation across sponsored ad products, spanning the shopper journey from awareness to purchase. * Develop rigorous approaches to incrementality measurement and long-term-sales modeling that ground optimization in true advertiser value. * Design and lead large-scale experiments and analyses to validate hypotheses and guide product direction. * Partner closely with engineering and product to define technical contracts, data schemas, and serving systems that carry models into production. * Raise the technical bar across science and engineering through mentorship, design reviews, and hands-on collaboration. * Grow scientific talent and publish impactful research internally and at top-tier venues.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 5+ years of hands-on work in predictive modeling and analysis experience * PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field * Experience working in predictive modeling and analysis * Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Knowledge of problem solving, algorithm design and complexity analysis * Experience creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art * Have peer-reviewed scientific contributions in premier journals and conferences

item.description:

We are looking for a Senior MLOps engineer to work closely with Data Scientists to build and deploy ML models on a modern MLOps stack.
As Lead Machine Learning Engineer on the Recommendation Engine team, you'll build and maintain pipelines for distributed model training on large compute clusters, batch/real-time model serving, hyperparameter tuning at scale, model monitoring, production validation and other activities vital for model development, testing and deployment in a well-managed, controlled environment.
Our product, Personalization and Insights, builds and supports high throughput, low latency applications which leverage state of the art machine learning architectures, and which are deployed in AWS. These applications power personalized experiences across Chase Consumer & Community Banking channels, to help weave a user experience that includes traditional banking services with other services in the Travel, Merchant Offer Shopping, and Dining spaces.

* Build, deploy, and maintain robust pipelines for distributed training on GPU-enabled clusters to support scalable machine learning workflows.
* Develop and manage pipelines for high-throughput, real-time inference as well as batch inference, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
* Implement quantization techniques and deploy large language models (LLMs) to maximize efficiency and resource utilization.
* Oversee the management and optimization of vector databases to support advanced AI and machine learning applications.
* Establish and maintain comprehensive monitoring and observability pipelines to ensure system health, performance, and rapid issue resolution.

item.title: Sr. Data Scientist, Performance Marketing - Pinterest
item.description:
**About Pinterest:**
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our marketing org. As a Senior Data Scientist you introduce greater scientific rigor into the marketing measurement and optimization processes to shape Pinterest's user growth and marketing strategy. The results of your work will influence and drive strategic decisions for the company - identify investment opportunities for growth, understand user growth and behavior, and define metrics to grow and sustain our user base. You will collaborate on a wide array of business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics, Data Engineering and others.
The role is within the Growth Marketing team, and would be supporting performance marketing efforts focused on driving user growth for Pinterest.
**What you'll do:**
* Deep strategic analysis to answer growth marketing ecosystem questions such as how to drive monthly active users from paid performance marketing, how to quantify the effect of paid performance marketing in new markets, how to drive user engagement and user LTV (lifetime value) from performance marketing. * Evolve our existing systems like geo-testing frameworks and other incrementality testing frameworks. * Build and deploy statistical and machine learning models such as propensity, forecasting, and lifetime value (LTV) models—to optimize marketing strategies and enhance audience targeting. * Develop new statistical models as well as maintain/improve existing models like user lifetime value models, budgeting models, long term user retention models etc. * Collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Data Engineering and others.
**Evolve our experimentation capabilities and tools to evaluate the business impact of performance marketing investment. Advise on experimentation best practices; identifying flaws in experiment practices and results; building tools for experiment analysis; etc.** **Identify the right measures of success for teams and help them track those metrics. Own the full lifecycle of those metrics from logging requirements, metrics definition, prototype pipelines, and improvements.**
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. * Write clear, actionable analyses that help teams uncover opportunities and identify areas of improvement to our existing strategies. * Design, maintain, and promote dashboards and automated reporting tools to empower stakeholders with self-serve, data-driven decision-making capabilities. Build and optimize ETL data pipelines to automate reporting, support deep dive analysis and feature engineering for analytical models.
**What we're looking for:**
* Minimum 5 years of combined post-graduate academic and industry experience applying scientific methods to solve real-world problems. * Master's degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, computer science or engineering. * Hands-on experiences with building marketing measurement solutions to quantify the business impact of marketing tactics and investments. * Strong background in statistics and quantitative analysis, with experience in applying advanced statistical techniques to real-world problems. * Expertise in at least one scripting language (ideally Python/R). * Proficiency in SQL/Hive. Ability to write efficient SQL queries. * Strong business and product sense. Strong skills in shaping vague questions into well-defined analyses and success metrics that drive business decisions. * Excellent communication skills, able to lead initiatives and communicate findings to the leadership and cross-functional teams. Explains work and thought processes clearly and concisely. * Experience leading key technical projects. * Strong Experimentation background. * Statistical rigor. Experience with causal inference projects.
**Relocation Statement:**
* This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
**In-Office Requirement Statement:**
* We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. * This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.
